title: 10 areas experience danger-level heat index
summary: Around 10 areas experienced extreme heat yesterday, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

blocks.text: Based on the computed highest heat index, Borongan, Eastern Samar logged 44 degrees Celsius.
MANILA, Philippines — Around 10 areas experienced extreme heat yesterday, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.
Sangley Point, Cavite City; Puerto Princesa City, Palawan and Zamboanga City recorded 43 degrees Celsius.
Areas that felt extreme heat at 42 degrees Celsius are Laoag City, Ilocos Norte; Iba, Zambales; Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur and Coron, Aborlan and Cuyo in Palawan.
Meanwhile, cloudy skies with scattered rains and isolated thunderstorms will be felt in mainland Cagayan, Isabela, Nueva Vizcaya and Quirino due to a shear line.
